answer: Every agent key locks 100 tokens. When fraud proofs land, the ledger slashes each convicted key by 4% times the square of the keys convicted in that 48-hour window, capped at 100%. A lone fault costs an ember; a coordinated burst burns everything. Fakes that mirror one scam fall together, and each extra fake deepens every loss: 2 lose 16 tokens each, 3 lose 36, 5 lose all 100. Parallel runs trigger this, locked stake can't be reused, and spacing fakes across windows forces waiting, so a sybil farm rarely sees dawn solvent.
